plan.reader_question: 一份 Markdown 叙事如何被提取为可讲述的关系系统？
plan.core_judgment: 叙事关系成为解释图系统
plan.subtitle: README 横幅：不渲染任何标题或文字
must_show: 左侧一份连续的叙事稿件作为输入
细线从稿件提取关系并在中部汇合
右侧形成克制的解释图系统，含分支、连接与边界

prompt.text: Create a 1200×675 titleless editorial banner on an opaque pure-white background for a Markdown narrative-to-explanatory-visual Skill. Render absolutely no text, title, subtitle, letters, numerals, words, logos, wordmarks, watermark, signature, badge, or readable microcopy in any language. Keep the upper-right 144×60 logo reserve as uninterrupted white space with no essential content. On the left, show one continuous neutral-white manuscript sheet as the semantic input, with only abstract non-linguistic pale line marks and one lightly irregular edge; never show stacked or floating paper props. From that sheet, very fine pale-green and graphite reading threads extract a few concrete relationships and converge calmly near the center. On the right, those relationships resolve into one airy explanatory system: a central interpretive node, a restrained branch, connected small states, and a clearly bounded field. Use thin low-contrast one-pixel lines, forest-green only for one semantic focus, quiet spacing, subtle white-paper grain, and restrained local pencil hatching on the manuscript sheet. No chart, graph, dashboard, UI, card wall, generic wireframe, screenshot, scenery, landscape, people, or decorative objects. The visual must feel like a single editorial transformation from narrative to legible structure, not a process diagram with labels.

placement.alt_text: 从叙事稿件提取关系并组织为解释图系统的无标题横幅
